summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of Career Buddha. Backend: 36/36 pytest cases pass covering auth, members/invite flow, features, resume parse (Gemini) + candidate DB + file download, clients CRUD, BD CRUD + AI suggest, joinings (member vs admin scoping), celebrations, heartbeat/online status, role-based access control, invalid Google session. Frontend: admin login works (must_change_password not triggered on this already-seeded DB), dashboard renders all 7 feature tabs + Admin Console tab; all tab navigation works; member creation via Admin Console succeeds and new member appears online after heartbeat; feature toggles (8) and client/lead add buttons visible and functional. No console errors.

minor.issue: Error returned when a user has status='invited' uses generic 401; message 'Please activate your account via your invite link first' is leaked. Low risk.
PUT returns {success:true} but does not return 404 when id not found; silently no-ops. Consider matched_count check.
Soft delete returns success even when candidate id does not exist.

issues: Email is displayed lower-cased which may differ from how the admin typed it (backend lowercases on store) — acceptable but worth noting

action_items: Optional: return 404 from PUT/DELETE endpoints when resource is missing (clients, bd, joinings, resumes)
Optional: do not reveal 'Please activate your account via your invite link first' at login to avoid email enumeration
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines mixing all domain areas (auth, admin, resumes, clients, bd, joinings, celebrations). Consider splitting into routers per module for maintainability.
/api/files accepts bearer in query param 'auth' - exposes token in server/CDN logs; mitigate by preferring Authorization header and limiting query-param tokens to short-lived download URLs.
bd/suggest performs an LLM call that can take long; no explicit timeout wrapper beyond httpx inside emergentintegrations — consider request-level timeout.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login — brute-force protection is missing (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails).
startup seeds admin only when missing — password rotation via env change won't update existing admin (document or add update logic).
allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — this combination is invalid per CORS spec; browsers may reject. Set explicit origins or disable credentials.
FEATURE_DEFAULTS has 8 keys but UI lists 8 toggles — ensure 'ai_bd_suggestions' key semantics are documented so admin knows what disabling does.
test_credentials: Admin: braj.raj@careerbuddha.in / CareerBuddha@2026 (must_change_password already cleared on this DB in prior admin manual testing). Members created with password MemberPass@2026 or via invite flow.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup TEST_ prefixed members, candidates, clients, bd leads, joinings. One UI_TEST_Org client and one UI member (TEST_ui_<timestamp>@example.com) left behind by UI smoke test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (36 tests, must be run with -n 0 or will cross-worker fail due to shared module-level state – or re-run as pytest -n 0). Admin password already set so must_change_password=false. Google OAuth cannot be fully tested (external session_id); only negative path verified. For UI, feature toggle testids are feature-toggle-{key}. All critical flows verified end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. The initial parallel pytest failure (-n 2 default) was a test design artifact (module-level MEMBER_IDS not shared across xdist workers) and not an app bug; running serially (-n 0) achieves 100% pass.
